relations.rationale: The smoothness of a trip has no bearing on Xavi's height or reaching shelves.
A smooth trip from another campus does not determine arrival order between Jude and Tess.
The smoothness of a trip is unrelated to whether games were finished during the session.
A smooth trip has no logical connection to Nell scheduling a follow-up meeting.
Traffic unpredictability has no bearing on the age difference between Ivo and Jude.
Traffic conditions do not relate to Ivo's seating choice near the radiator.
Traffic near a roundabout has nothing to do with Ivo's sensitivity to cold.
Unpredictable traffic could plausibly delay someone's arrival, but this alone doesn't establish that Tess arrived before Ivo.
Traffic conditions are unrelated to Jude's practice habits during the week.
Traffic unpredictability has no bearing on Jude's eagerness to try a new opening variation.
Traffic conditions have no relation to the scoring system used for the next match.
Traffic near a roundabout is unrelated to members' confusion about the rating system.
Traffic unpredictability alone does not establish who arrived first between Ivo and Jude.
Traffic conditions have no bearing on whether the advisor checked attendance.
Traffic near the roundabout is unrelated to scoresheets being left on a table.
Traffic conditions have no logical connection to Xavi's height.
Traffic unpredictability is unrelated to Xavi's ability to reach shelves.
Traffic conditions alone do not determine the arrival order of Jude and Tess.
Traffic near a roundabout is unrelated to whether games were finished by session's end.
Traffic unpredictability has no bearing on Nell's promise to schedule a meeting.
